boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Los Angeles
boards.description: Ten current, under-21-safe food destinations on or near UCLA with directly verified late availability.

cards.title: Fat Sal's Westwood
cards.subtitle: 972 Gayley Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Use the Gayley Avenue location for a late food stop; its official location page lists daily service through 2:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood sandwich shop with daily 2:00 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Sal's Westwood at 972 Gayley Ave lists daily hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; check the page for changes before going.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Gayley
cards.subtitle: 922 Gayley Ave, north of Wilshire
cards.notes: Head to the location identified by In-N-Out as south of UCLA; regular hours run to 1:00 a.m., later Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A directly adjacent UCLA-area In-N-Out with 1:00 a.m. regular closing.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's 922 Gayley location lists regular hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Bruxie Westwood UCLA
cards.subtitle: 1114 Gayley Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Plan around the day: the restaurant's direct ordering page lists midnight closing Sunday through Tuesday and 2:00 a.m. Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Waffle sandwiches and chicken with midnight-to-2:00 a.m. availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Bruxie Westwood UCLA lists hours until midnight Sunday–Tuesday and 2:00 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Bruxie Westwood UCLA — Order and Hours
cards.access_notes: Direct restaurant ordering page lists 8:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Sunday–Tuesday and 8:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday.

cards.title: 800° Woodfired Kitchen Westwood
cards.subtitle: 10889 Lindbrook Dr, Westwood
cards.notes: Use the Lindbrook Drive location when its later schedule fits: the official page lists midnight closing Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Wood-fired kitchen with Thursday–Saturday service to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: 800° Woodfired Kitchen Westwood lists hours until midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; other listed days close at 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Tu Madre Westwood
cards.subtitle: 1945 Westwood Blvd, Westwood
cards.notes: This Westwood Boulevard restaurant lists no cocktail or spirit menu at this location and posts daily service through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood counter-service option that lists midnight hours daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Tu Madre's Westwood page states that cocktails and spirits are unavailable there and lists hours until 12:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and 10:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Pinches Tacos Westwood
cards.subtitle: 1030 Glendon Ave, Westwood Village
cards.notes: Choose Friday or Saturday for the later window; the official locations page lists this Glendon Avenue shop open until 10:00 p.m. those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood Village taco shop with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pinches Tacos Westwood lists 9:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 9:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday close at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: De Neve Dining
cards.subtitle: UCLA residential Hill
cards.notes: For a campus-based late option, check the live dining schedule before leaving; UCLA notes De Neve's extended dinner begins at 10:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A UCLA dining hall with a documented extended-dinner period.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA's ASUCLA dining guide states that extended dinner generally runs 9:00 p.m.–midnight and that De Neve begins extended dinner at 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: ASUCLA documents extended dinner through midnight and says De Neve starts its extended dinner at 10:00 p.m.; confirm the live schedule for the date.

cards.title: Diddy Riese Cookies
cards.subtitle: 926 Broxton Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Use the official store page to time a dessert stop: it lists 10:00 p.m. closings Tuesday through Thursday and 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Cookies and ice cream with listed late-evening Westwood hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Diddy Riese lists hours until 10:00 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists Tuesday–Thursday noon–10:00 p.m. and Friday–Saturday noon–11:00 p.m.; it is closed Monday.

cards.title: Tacos 1986 Westwood Village
cards.subtitle: 10874 Kinross Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday option for the latest listed window; the official Westwood page posts midnight closing on both nights.
cards.short_summary: A Kinross Avenue taco destination open to midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos 1986's Westwood Village page lists Friday and Saturday hours from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 8:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: CSO Evening Escort Service
cards.subtitle: UCLA campus, local living areas, and Westwood Village
cards.notes: If walking from campus after food, UCLA's CSO escort service covers campus and Westwood Village from dusk until 1:00 a.m.; request it in advance.
cards.short_summary: A UCLA safety resource available for late walks within its service area.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA states that CSO escorts are available from dusk until 1:00 a.m. between campus buildings, local living areas, and Westwood Village within stated boundaries.
cards.source_title: UCLA Police Department — CSO Safety Escort Service
cards.access_notes: UCLA's CSO evening escort service is available from dusk until 1:00 a.m.; review the stated service boundaries and request process before relying on it.

warnings: The final card is a late-night safety service rather than a food destination; it is included because it directly supports safer late-night access around UCLA.
